# EmaPark

> > EmaPark is a vacation rentals and international property investment platform specializing in emerging markets across the Caribbean, Caucasus, and global destinations.

EmaPark provides comprehensive guides for foreign investors interested in purchasing vacation rental properties and real estate in emerging markets, with particular focus on Azerbaijan (Baku), Dominican Republic (Punta Cana, Puerto Plata, Las Terrenas), and Caribbean destinations including the Bahamas and St. Barts.

## Key Topics

- Foreign property ownership regulations
- International real estate investment
- Vacation rental properties
- Azerbaijan real estate market (Baku, Caspian Sea region)
- Dominican Republic investment opportunities
- Caribbean property markets
- Tourism-driven rental income
- Property buying processes for foreigners
- Land ownership restrictions
- State Register of Real Estate (Azerbaijan)
- Investor visa programs
- Punta Cana and Puerto Plata developments
- Emerging market real estate
- Cross-border property transactions

## International Property Investment Guides

- [Can Foreigners Buy Property in Azerbaijan?](https://emapark.com/can-foreigners-buy-property-in-azerbaijan): Guide on foreign property ownership rules in Azerbaijan, covering Baku
- [Why Invest in Real Estate in the Dominican Republic?](https://emapark.com/why-invest-in-real-estate-in-the-dominican-republic): Investment guide for Dominican Republic real estate in Punta Cana area
